scope.purpose: admit at most one continuous-ranker formulation to an independent broad benchmark
scope.on_admission_failure: stop and report the failed gate; do not tune against the same data

estimand.regret_definition: best heldout envelope R2 minus the best envelope R2 retained by the selected backbone or shortlist
estimand.aggregation: pool candidates within a source-task group, then average source-task groups before cross-source summaries

uncertainty.tie_definition: a pair is practically equivalent when its complete 95% difference interval lies inside [-0.01, 0.01] R2
uncertainty.unresolved_definition: a pair is unresolved when neither material order nor practical equivalence is established
uncertainty.selection_rule: use conservative regret intervals; do not force unresolved pairs into a total order

one_change_requires: a diagnosis-to-change mapping declared before Step-2 outcomes
proof that Step-2 outcomes were not used to tune the change
step2_entry.failure_action: a method that does not survive the mechanism diagnostic cannot enter this gate

reference_admission.rank_change_rule: a nonlinear opportunity needs sufficient training-only Linear CV regret headroom and either a lower-bound Linear CV top1 regret above 0.01 R2 or at least two material pair reversals
reference_admission.headroom_rule: a nonlinear advantage claim is inadmissible when the 95% lower bound on deployable training-only Linear CV top1 regret is at or below 0.01 R2, even if a point estimate or a nonlinear head gain is large

data_design.reserved_backbone_definition: backbones absent from mechanism development and all scout outcomes, evaluated only after method and data roles are locked
data_design.confirmation_is_separate: a future general claim still needs at least three qualified nonlinear and three linear-control source datasets, plus an unopened confirmation roster

capacity_grid.dimension_semantics: native dimensions are measured and reported per backbone; these real-embedding checkpoints are expected scaling targets when supported, while the synthetic grid is supplementary and cannot replace native dimensions
capacity_grid.sample_semantics: training rows per draw; no row cloning or repeated addition after results

runtime.thread_control: one documented CPU thread configuration shared by methods

success.decision: all required strata, separate shortlist metrics, material-pair ordering, complete runtime cells, and uncertainty fields must pass

stop_rule.method_comparison: one method may be independently evaluated only after entry passes
stop_rule.after_failure: stop the formulation family; do not tune, reselect, add rows, remove disagreement, or reopen the same benchmark
stop_rule.after_one_formulation_change: run the independent evaluation once; any further formulation change is disallowed under this protocol
stop_rule.near_ties: retain unresolved candidates in the report and do not call a winner
stop_rule.no_claim_without_headroom: a positive nonlinear-head gain without sufficient achievable LP-regret headroom is not a nonlinear backbone-ranking opportunity

rationale.threshold_changes: No quality or uncertainty margin was relaxed. The newer gate adds an explicit 0.01 R2 lower-bound LP-headroom check, requires two fresh source groups and two reserved backbones before broad comparison, and treats 1.0x as the time-competitive ceiling while retaining 0.5x as the preferred target.
rationale.why_headroom_is_required: The latest holdout had nonlinear head wins but only 0.0022 R2 LP selection regret; an apparent nonlinear opportunity could not deliver the claimed improvement at that margin.
rationale.why_new_groups_and_reserved_backbones_ar: Repeated scout panels and same-source target channels cannot establish cross-source or unseen-roster generalization; prior broad comparisons had zero reserved backbones.
rationale.why_shortlist_is_separate: A method can improve top-three opportunity regret while worsening top-one regret, so shortlist utility cannot substitute for winner selection.
